Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States. Position Summary The Full Stack AWS & Azure Developer will design, develop, and maintain robust cloud solutions across AWS and Azure platforms. This role focuses on full stack development using C# for backend services, integrated with an Angular frontend and modern cloud infrastructure. The developer will build scalable, secure applications and hybrid cloud integrations, ensuring high performance and compliance with industry standards. Experience with MikroTik or similar networking products is highly desirable to assist with hardware-cloud integrations. Optimize Performance : Identify and implement application features that improve speed, security, and cloud efficiency. Document Work : Create comprehensive documentation for system designs, API endpoints, and deployment procedures. Review & Test : Perform regular unit testing and conduct peer code reviews to maintain high code quality. Provide Support : Offer Level 2/3 troubleshooting support for complex application and cloud infrastructure issues. Stay Updated : Monitor advancements in AWS, Azure, and Angular ecosystems to pitch continuous product upgrades. Requirements Education : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Master’s degree is a plus). Experience : Minimum of 3 years of continuous experience in full stack application development and cloud engineering. Frontend Skills : Strong proficiency in Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3. Backend Skills : Strong proficiency in C# and .NET Core framework for building backend services. Cloud Platforms : Hands-on experience deploying and managing resources in both AWS and Azure environments. Database Knowledge : Proficiency with SQL (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases. DevOps & CI/CD : Experience setting up automated pipelines using Git, AWS Code Pipeline, or Azure DevOps. Nice to Have Certifications : AWS Certified Developer, Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate, or relevant networking credentials. #LI-TE1 This position is eligible to earn a discretionary bonus based on performance metrics and other criteria outlined in our applicable bonus plan.
